name: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (alias for $KTOS)
blurb: Posters occasionally write $KRATOS for Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, whose actual NASDAQ ticker is $KTOS. Kratos builds unmanned aerial systems (Valkyrie XQ-58A), satellite ground systems, propulsion components, and turbine engines for defense customers.
recent: KTOS shares rallied through 2025-2026 on Pentagon CCA (Collaborative Combat Aircraft) program wins and persistent congressional buying disclosed in periodic transaction reports.
